prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: Captain Livé modular HAIR ONLY, one four-view sheet for model reconstruction.

Image 1 is the approved full-character turnaround: match its exact dark warm-brown curly shoulder-length hair and sideburns, including its loose outward-hooked ringlets and uneven pointed locks. Image 2 is the new bare-head fit reference; its head is NOT part of this deliverable. Use it only to fit the wig around the skull, ears, temples and long nape.

Draw ONLY one coherent removable HAIR WIG seen from four angles. No face, head, neck, skin, ears, eyes, eyebrows, moustache, chin tuft, beard, clothing, hat, feather, mannequin, display stand or attachment peg. The sideburns belong to this wig: include the same short tapered dark-brown locks along both temples and in front of both ear openings, continuous with the hair. Do not include any moustache or beard.

Design: the approved captain's rich dark chocolate-brown loose curly shoulder-length hair, broad readable sculpted ringlets with a few narrow stray curled tips. Longest locks just reach the shirt collar at the lower nape. Keep it lean rather than a giant fluffy mane. The unshown crown underneath his hat is a simple snug low-profile hair cap continuing his swept-back waves, not a new pompadour or high quiff. Maintain the same hairline and sideburn position across all four views. Natural outward-splaying curls at the sides and lower back. A real wearable hollow wig, no solid head-shaped filling. In the front, the face area is EMPTY WHITE BACKGROUND between the two hanging sides, and the ear cutouts remain open. In the side views, preserve the hollow open face/ear edge rather than drawing a filled brown silhouette of a head. In the back, show the full back hair and falling curls. Clear background gaps between separated curl tips.

One single coherent wide landscape image, 3:1, four equal-width cells in one row. Exactly these views left to right: FRONT, LEFT SIDE, BACK, RIGHT SIDE. Orthographic camera at hair midpoint height, straight-on front/rear and exact profiles, no three-quarter views or perspective. Same physical hair, same camera scale and exactly shared highest crown elevation and lowest curl elevation across all four views. Keep each silhouette entirely inside the central 70% of its own cell. Broad full-height empty white separator bands. Whole wig and every curl visible with generous top/bottom margin.

Fit: the wig is for the SAME Captain whose approved complete silhouette including hat feather is 1.90 m tall. Hair component approximately 0.32 m high, shaped around the supplied head. Frame the standalone wig large enough to read, but never independently enlarge a view or alter the head-fitting dimensions across views.

Match the reference's cartoony adventure-game rendering and softly dimensional broad form shading. Warm dark brown hair, subdued medium-brown highlights, no photorealistic strands or metallic gloss. One consistent soft even neutral light. Flat pure white #FFFFFF everywhere outside the wig, including all corners and gaps. No grain, shadows, contact shadow, ground, scene, text, callouts, borders, labels, numbers or baseline line.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit ONLY the vertical consistency of this Captain Livé HAIR-ONLY four-view modeling sheet. Keep the same hair, same brown colour and shading, every major curl, same empty face/ear openings, same sideburns, same four straight orthographic views, FRONT LEFT BACK RIGHT. Do not add a head, mannequin, face, hat, other item, text or shadow.

The wigs have drifted in length: front is too short, back too long. They must all show the same physical wig, same camera scale and SAME highest and lowest elevations. Set all four crown tops on one horizontal level and every view's lowest visible hair tip on one common horizontal baseline. Aim for top y=115 and bottom y=600 in a 2172×724 canvas. Keep the overall figure height and width scaling identical, with no independent resizing.

Keep the side profiles as the length master. Extend only the few lowest front hair tips slightly to the side profiles' lowest level, and shorten/tuck up the few lowest back-center hair tips to that SAME level. Keep all other locks unchanged and preserve the shoulder-length hair silhouette. The longest side/back locks must also be visible in the front elevation where appropriate; no hidden imaginary mannequin occluding them.

Center each whole wig in its own equal quarter of the canvas, with broad clean vertical white gaps and no curl crossing a cell boundary. Flat pure white #FFFFFF background; no paper grain, gradient, colour cast or vignetting. Do not draw the common baseline or cell boundaries. Entire components fully visible.

included: Short tapered sideburns continuous with the temple hair
design.inference: The crown concealed under the approved hat is completed as a low swept-back cap of hair. The visible curls, length, sideburns and colour follow the approved character.
design.cavity: White background is visible through the empty face and both ear openings, with clear gaps between lower curl tips. The generated model still requires checking for a solid head fill.

turnaround.requested_projection: orthographic elevations at one fixed camera scale
turnaround.background: Visually white, generated RGB noise near 253–255; not pixel-flat pure #FFFFFF.
turnaround.lighting: Soft even form shading remains on the hair; no cast shadow or ground plane.

validation.command: python tools/crop_views.py art/characters/captain_live/pieces/hair/sheet.png --names front left back right --row 0 1 --out <scratch> --dry-run --preview <scratch-preview>
validation.native_bbox_measurement: RGB absolute difference from white summed over channels >54; inclusive bounds.
notes: Identity, matching sideburns, open face/ear spaces and four-view separation reviewed.
All crown tops share y=113; native lower curl tips retain a 5 px spread after correction.
Automatic view cutter aligns bottoms on extraction but does not normalize the 5 px height difference.
Actual metre fit, cavity and final reconstructed curls require checking in Tripo and assembly.
Final extraction was run successfully after the fingertip-preservation fix; four nonempty PNGs open at native square size with matching baselines and no omitted foreground.
